Regular run a few notes for anyone with a companion animal
Please read this before you travel
Companion Animal Travel Desk notice

Travelers need to check their carrier, documents, and pet comfort before arrival so boarding does not stall.

We are seeing tighter checks today, so keep your animal calm, leashed, or secured as required, and bring any feeding or care items you need for the trip. If your pet is moving through quarantine handling, follow the desk guidance exactly and do not improvise at the gate. <<FACT F025>> Speak up early if your plans have changed, because late changes can slow the whole flow.

On busy departures, space and handling can tighten fast, so arrive with everything ready and keep your paperwork close. <<FACT F008>> If your pet shows stress, let the staff know right away and we will step through the next move with you in a calm, orderly way. Aurelia Skyways wants every companion trip to stay safe and smooth, but that only works when travelers follow the instructions and respond quickly to staff direction.

For help, go straight to the Companion Animal Travel Desk.
